rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR MALVERSATION OF PUBLIC FUNDS, ROBBERY OR THEFT OF RELIEF GOODS INTENDED FOR CALAMITY VICTIMS
rows.abstract: Provides for the following ----- "Secrtion 1. Any person who commits malversation of public funds, robbery or theft of relief goods intended for calamity victims shall be punished by an imprisonment of not less twelve years or more than twenty years, or a fine equivalent to the amount embezzled, robbed or unlawfully taken, but in no case less than twenty thousand pesos (P20,000.00), or both such fine and imprisonment, at the discretion of the court.  In case the offender is a government official/employ ee, he shall, in addition to the penalty provided herein, be dismissed from the service and disqualified from holding any public office.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-11-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOWING NEWLY ESTABLISHED CORPORATIONS OR FIRMS NEWLY VENTURING INTO OTHER LINES OR AREAS OF BUSINESS TO DEDUCT THEIR OPERATIONAL LOSSES DURING THE TAXABLE YEAR AND THE YEAR THEREAFTER, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE SECTION 29 (2) OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Declares that NEWLY ESTABLISHED CORPORATIONS, OR EXISTING COMPANIES NEWLY VENTURING INTO OTHER OR NEW LINES OR AREAS OF BUSINESS, SHALL BE ALLOWED, DURING THEIR FIRST TWO (2) YEARS OF OPERATION, TO CARRY OVER AS DEDUCTION FROM THEIR GROSS INCOME INTHE SUCCEEDING YEAR THE OPERATING LOSS THEY MAY INCUR DURING THE TAXABLE YEAR; PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT ANY PORTION OF SUCH LOSS WHICH IS IN EXCESS OF THE TAXABLE INCOME SHALL BE DEDUCTED FROM THE GROSS INCOME OF THE SUCCEEDING YEARS BUT NOT BEYOND THE THIRD YEAR OF THEIR OPERATION. OPERATING LOSS SHALL MEAN THE LOSS ARISING FROM AND ACTUALLY SUSTAINED BY THE CORPORATION IN THE CONDUCT OR OPERATION OF ITS BUSINESS OR TRADE WITHIN THE TAXABLE YEAR AND NOT COMPENSATED FOR BY INSURANCE OR OTHERWISE.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09077
